messages:
jamie (partnerships): Quick sync — Snowflake vector connector + Databricks + Qdrant pilot. also need to confirm AWS Marketplace hardware listing (NVIDIA A10x) timing. who can run the final compatibility matrix?
sarah (eng-ml): I ran the nightly connector tests against Snowflake dev account. two failures: quantized 4-bit model errors in UDF path. attaching minimal repro.
sarah (eng-ml): ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "connector_udf.py", line 48, in handler
    output = model.generate(input)
RuntimeError: unsupported dtype for KV cache
```
jamie (partnerships): ugh. thanks. @luis can your team look at the UDF packaging? this blocks the Snowflake listing.
luis (partner-eng): on it. initial thought: runtime picks FP16 kernels, quantization shim isn't loaded inside Snowflake UDF sandbox. need a small wrapper to set env var and load shim before model init. can prototype by EOD.
alex (product): marketing wants a joint announcement the week of Apr 7. if this fails, we should push to Apr 21. legal needs marketplace PR review too. luis, can you confirm ETA for the wrapper?
luis (partner-eng): ETA EOD for prototype, full validation by Thu. will create a checklist in the shared drive.
kevin (field-eng): I can run perf matrix once wrapper is ready. quick perf sanity command I use: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-q4","input":"test"}' | jq '.latency'`
kevin (field-eng): rough numbers: p50 85ms p95 430ms (on A10x, batching=4). will validate on Databricks runtime too.
partners-bot: Marketplace publish checklist: https://drive.redwood/marketplace/checklist (items: legal signoff, billing SKU, console tile, partner logos, HW cert docs). :page_facing_up:
jamie (partnerships): also remember to confirm vector DB compatibility tests with Qdrant + Pinecone. we need sample ingest + query perf for our docs. kevin can you add that to your runbook?
kevin (field-eng): yup. I'll run ingest (10k vectors) and query (10k nearest) and log throughput/latency. putting results in /reports/partners/1805129999.
sarah (eng-ml): FYI Databricks connector shows no UDF sandbox issue — tests pass there. just Snowflake needs the shim. different runtime behavior.
luis (partner-eng): filing an internal issue: PART-4827 "Snowflake UDF: quantization shim load" and linking prototype PR once ready.
jamie (partnerships): decision: target Apr 21 announcement unless all checks green by Apr 7. owners: luis (wrapper + Snowflake cert), kevin (perf + DB tests), sarah (unit tests & repro), alex (marketing + legal). I'll send calendar invite for weekly checkpoints. :calendar:
alex (product): noted. I'll start the PRD for marketplace tile and draft joint announcement. need partner logos by Tue.
kevin (field-eng): quick note — for hardware listing we need the GPU test matrix (A10x/A30/A100) and power/profile screenshots. I'll coordinate with infra.
jamie (partnerships): great. if anyone hits a blocker ping #release-war-room. thanks all — will follow up with invite and the checklist link.
